Serenity and the City

Have you ever dreamed of living in San Francisco, Paris, and the Italian countryside all at once? If so, prepare to be utterly captivated by 49 Liberty Street #2. Nestled in the heart of the Liberty Hill Historic district, this enchanting upper-level condo is surrounded by lush greenery, mature trees, and iconic San Francisco landmarks. It's the epitome of city living at its finest.

This exceptionally chic and sophisticated one-bedroom, one-bathroom condo is located on the top floor of a stunning 1880 Italianate Victorian 4-unit building. With breathtaking views of picturesque, tree-lined Liberty Street, the rooms boast soaring ceilings, wood floors, beautiful chandeliers, and intricate architectural details. The spacious bedroom features majestic windows, a decorative fireplace, a cozy seating area, and a generous closet. The living room offers a lovely view of the garden and opens to the sunlit kitchen, with access to your exclusive deck and one of the most magical backyards in San Francisco.

Shared with the other units, the south-facing backyard is over 1,500 square feet of professionally designed and landscaped gardens, stone walkways, and a delightful outdoor eating area. Perfect for enjoying a morning coffee or hosting large gatherings, this oasis will transport you to a serene Wine Country retreat. With ample storage, laundry, and garage parking, this special city home has everything you need.

Just steps from the vibrant Valencia Street restaurants and shops, yet offering a world unto itself, this exceptional property is a rare jewel in San Francisco. Come visit, stay awhile, and fall in love with the magic of the Italianate Victorian at 49 Liberty #2.

12-months lease. Owner pays for garbage/recycling, the Internet/Wi-Fi, and HOA dues. Renter is responsible for gas, electric, and water. No smoking allowed. First month's rent is due at signing. Security deposit is 1 month rent.
